hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb line in the foreground and middle ground.

hazards.name: Wide Roadway and Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The four-lane roadway with additional parking lanes creates a wide expanse for pedestrians to cross without a median or refuge island.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway across the entire visible stretch

hazards.name: Large Vehicle Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: The Sysco truck and SEPTA bus block sightlines between pedestrians on the sidewalk and drivers in the roadway, increasing the risk of mid-block crossing accidents.
hazards.location_in_image: Center and left foreground of the roadway

hazards.name: Poor Roadway Condition
hazards.description: The asphalt is heavily cracked and patched, creating potential hazards for vehicles and pedestrians crossing mid-block.
hazards.location_in_image: Roadway surface in the foreground

hazards.name: Sightline Obstructions
hazards.description: A large street tree and a parked SUV partially block the view between the sidewalk and the travel lane.
hazards.location_in_image: Curb area in front of the Elks Center

hazards.name: Unsignalized Mid-block Crossing
hazards.description: A marked crosswalk exists mid-block without any traffic signals or flashing beacons to alert drivers to pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Center left of the image, across the roadway.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Parked cars and a bus near the crossing area can block the line of sight between pedestrians entering the crosswalk and oncoming drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb on the far side of the street, near the crosswalk.

hazards.name: Wide Roadway Crossing
hazards.description: Four travel lanes plus parking lanes create a long, unprotected crossing distance for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the center of the roadway.

hazards.name: Large Vehicle Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: A large pickup truck parked at the curb obscures the view between the sidewalk and the roadway for both pedestrians and drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground, parked along the curb.

hazards.name: High-Speed Slip Lane
hazards.description: A channelized right-turn lane allows vehicles to maintain higher speeds during turns, creating a conflict point with pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the intersection

hazards.name: Lack of sidewalk buffer
hazards.description: The sidewalk is directly adjacent to the roadway with no physical buffer like trees or a planting strip to protect pedestrians from traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Far side sidewalk in front of buildings

hazards.name: Lack of Designated Crossings
hazards.description: No marked crosswalks or pedestrian signals are visible, which may lead to unsafe midblock crossings on this high-volume street.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire visible roadway stretch

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian-vehicle buffer
hazards.description: There is no physical separation, such as trees, bollards, or parked cars, between the high-capacity roadway and the pedestrian walkway.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb line separating the sidewalk from the street

hazards.name: Sidewalk obstructions
hazards.description: Trash bags and utility poles are placed within the walkway, narrowing the effective clear path.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the sidewalk near the curb

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to provide a safe waiting area for pedestrians crossing the wide roadway.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Add a marked midblock crossing with high-visibility paint and pedestrian-actuated warning beacons.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at potential crossing points to reduce crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Lane Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of travel lanes to the NACTO standard of 10-11 feet to naturally calm traffic speeds.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planters
interventions.description: Install a furniture zone with street trees or planters to provide a physical buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway.

interventions.title: Road Diet
interventions.description: Reconfigure the roadway to reduce the number of through lanes, which can slow traffic and provide space for dedicated bike lanes or wider buffers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Mid-block Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with high-visibility paint and pedestrian warning signs to provide a designated crossing point.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light.

interventions.title: Street Lighting
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and perceived safety during nighttime hours.

interventions.title: Active Frontage or Public Art
interventions.description: Incorporate murals or public art on the blank walls to improve the visual environment and reduce the sense of isolation.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Add more street trees or a planting strip to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Mark crossings with continental or ladder patterns to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crossing with Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with a central refuge island to break up the crossing distance and provide a safe waiting area.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Introduce street furniture, planters, or a parking lane to create a protective barrier for pedestrians from moving traffic.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with high-visibility continental markings and appropriate signage to provide a safe crossing point near the childcare center.

interventions.title: Protected Bike Lane or Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Repurpose a portion of the wide roadway to include a protected bike lane or a wider sidewalk buffer to increase separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Green Buffer
interventions.description: Introduce street trees or a planting strip to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway.

interventions.title: Roadway Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair the cracked and degraded pavement to improve safety and drainage.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Introduce a furniture zone with benches, planters, or bike racks to create a physical and psychological buffer from traffic.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Implement a buffer zone with trees or street furniture to separate pedestrians from the roadway.

interventions.title: Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons (RRFB)
interventions.description: Add user-actuated amber LEDs to crossing signs to increase driver yielding rates at this mid-block location.

interventions.title: Marked Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: Add a high-visibility marked crosswalk with appropriate signage or signals to facilitate safe crossing between intersections.

interventions.title: Slip Lane Removal
interventions.description: Eliminate the high-speed turn lane to reduce conflict points and slow down turning traffic.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Green Infrastructure
interventions.description: Add street trees or planters to create a vertical buffer between the sidewalk and the travel lanes.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions and On-Street Parking
interventions.description: Repurpose the outer lanes for on-street parking or curb extensions to narrow the perceived roadway and provide a buffer for the sidewalk.

interventions.title: Mid-block Pedestrian Crossing
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility mid-block crossing with a pedestrian refuge island to facilitate safe crossing between commercial destinations.
